items.Sentence: The wastewater treatment process uses two identical treatment trains, each with an average daily dry weather flow capacity of 0.02 MGD. Each train consists of grinding, influent screening, flow equalization (primary clarification), extended aeration, secondary clarification, chlorination (using sodium hypochlorite), and dechlorination (using sodium bisulfite).
The Discharger is considering replacing the use of chlorine for disinfection with an ultraviolet (UV) light disinfection system, potentially during this Order term.
